posts.text:
There was a shooting near the White House involving secret service. Shooter reported dead; not a mass shooting

Make no assumptions, believe no random images of tweets, and remember that the answer to our problems will not be found by scrolling further
sorry sir but all the dishes labelled (gf) on the menu are only for girlfriends
It’s helpful to know she is the coolest, now I don’t have to worry about
Boggles the mind that people like him exist and, further, will compose and post stuff like that on the internet with nary a second thought in sight

My desperate plea to all corporations: STOP trying to push your own custom-named AI chat bot. I do not want to "Ask Jeremiah" or "Consult Jopajak" or "Query Binkybonk" I just want to log in to my god damn dashboard
The culprit cooked biscuits, shrimp and fries, police say
This dude better set the record for largest settlement payout to a non-citizen in US history
I am not a proponent of political dynasties but given that the US at large generally is, Hunter Biden has the opportunity to do the funniest thing
Judge dismisses human smuggling charges against Kilmar Ábrego García
Gonna rig my front door to play Pokémon gym music when it opens and set up a bunch of traps and puzzles and then invite all the neighborhood kids to come by and fight me
I did a lot of back-of-the-napkin math in today’s episode and came up with some interesting calculations

In case you missed it earlier, here is this week's episode of Stuff Keeps Happening!

www.youtube.com/watch?v=O1sj...
I want to see an alien recreation of what a human would look like based solely on a Nintendo 64 controller
In part because there is a criminal lack of good delis near me
A friend of mine has been lobbying for our friend group to all just quit our jobs and open a deli and every day I get a little closer to agreeing
Haha, yes! This unsourced infographic reinforces my preexisting bias! Time to never question my own decision making and let this calcify my assumptions~~

Today's Stuff Keeps Happening is out!

A look at a recent win for labor unions as well as a deep dive into Trump's new political slush fund

Watch here: youtu.be/O1sjVwvzq4Y
One more for good measure
Today's mid-edit screenshot
our sitting president threatened to "end a whole civilization" barely a month ago and he’s still sittin’
